tagline: Integrated Logistics Solutions Across Multiple Transportation Modes
hero_kpi_rationale: Core segment representing 66% of consolidated revenue, with relative stability (-0.6% YoY) in a challenging market environment characterized by lower pricing and declining freight volumes

kpis.name: Asset-Based Segment Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the Asset-Based segment, primarily related to transportation and logistics services provided by ABF Freight System, Inc.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline due to lower pricing and reduced freight volumes

kpis.name: Asset-Light Segment Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the Asset-Light segment, including MoLo Solutions, Panther Premium Logistics, and other logistics and transportation subsidiaries
kpis.signal: Revenue decline due to lower pricing and reduced freight volumes in a challenging market environment

kpis.name: Consolidated Operating Income
kpis.description: Consolidated operating income before taxes and interest expenses, reflecting the combined performance of the Asset-Based and Asset-Light segments
kpis.signal: Significant decline in operating income due to lower revenues and rising costs in the Asset-Based segment

kpis.name: Asset-Based Segment Revenue in 2025
kpis.description: Asset-Based segment revenue in 2025, primarily related to freight transportation and logistics services from ABF Freight System, Inc.
kpis.signal: Slight revenue decline despite a 1.2% increase in tonnage per day, driven by lower weight-based pricing and reduced fuel surcharges

risks.title: Cybersécurité
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its information and technology systems for logistics operations, making it vulnerable to cyberattacks and disruptions to critical systems.

risks.title: Concurrence
risks.score_rationale: The logistics and transportation services market is highly competitive, with numerous players creating pricing pressures and market share challenges.

risks.title: Régulation
risks.score_rationale: Changes in government regulations could significantly impact company operations, particularly regarding emissions, safety standards, and working hours.

risks.title: Géopolitique
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events such as conflicts, trade tariffs, and sanctions could disrupt supply chains and logistics operations.

risks.title: Capital et liquidité
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its financial resources to fund investments in vehicle fleets and technology, which could be affected by market conditions.

risks.title: Litige et responsabilité
risks.score_rationale: The company faces litigation risks related to transportation accidents, driver injuries, and civil liability claims.

risks.title: Réputation
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation among customers, partners, and regulators is critical to its success in the competitive logistics sector.

ai_positioning.summary: AI is referenced through the Vaux technology suite (Vaux Freight Movement System, Vaux Smart Autonomy, Vaux Vision), with development costs reducing operating results. However, AI is not a central component of the company's overall strategy.
evidence: Vaux suite costs: $29.1M (pre-tax) in 2025 vs $34.1M in 2024
Vaux Smart Autonomy et Vaux Vision mentioned as technology initiatives
Asset impairment charges of $12.0M in Q4 2025 related to write-off of obsolete Vaux suite assets
